narration: The content branch takes an input image and extracts low-rank feature adaptations using the Content LoRA.
Simultaneously, the style reference image is processed through the Style LoRA to capture target aesthetic features.
Within K-LoRA, key content activation elements are identified and summed based on top-K scores.
The style top-K elements are scaled and multiplied to calibrate their relative influence against content.
A Judge module arbitrates between content and style weights, producing an integrated attention layer with a larger Top-K.
The refined attention features are added back into the target layer of the generative diffusion backbone.
Finally, the model generates the synthesized output, seamlessly fusing the original content with the target style.
